questions.question: If p + ( {(1)/(p)} ) = 2 find the value of p × p × p
questions.solution:

(p) + (1/p) = 2

If (a) + (1/a) = 2, then a will always be equal to 1

**Calculation:**

Using concept,

questions.question: If the perimeter and breadth of a rectangle are in the ratio 6 ∶ 1 and the area of the rectangle is 288 cm². Find the length of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of the rectangle is 288 cm²

The perimeter and breadth of a rectangle are in the ratio 6 ∶ 1

**Formula used:**

Area if rectangle = length × breadth

Perimeter = 2(length + breadth)

**Calculation:**

Length = l, breadth = b

According to question,

2(l + b)/b = 6/1

⇒ 2l + 2b = 6b

⇒ 4b = 2l

⇒ l/b = 2/1

So, length = 2X, breadth = X 

Area of rectangle = 288

⇒ (2X × X) = 288

⇒ 2X² = 288

⇒ X² = 144

⇒ X = 12

**∴ ****Length of rectangle is 24 cm.**

questions.question: A person covers 700 m distance in 6 minutes. What is his speed in km/h?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A person covers 700 m distance in 6 minutes

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/time

**Calculation:**

Speed = v, Distance = 700 meter, time = 6 minutes

v = 700/6 (m/minute)

Here,

1 m = 1/1000 km

1 minute= 1/60 hour

⇒ v = (700/1000)/(6/60)

⇒ v = (700 × 60)/(6 × 1000)

⇒ v = 7km/hr

**∴**** His speed in km/h is 7km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Any speed change from m/minute to km/hr so multiply by 3/50

And speed change from km/hr to m/minute so multiply by 50/3

Here,

v = (700/6) × (3/50)

⇒ v = 70/10 km/hr

⇒ v = 7 km/hr

questions.question: Find the perimeter of a right angle triangle whose sides have sizes of 5 cm and 12 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides of the right-angled triangle are 5 cm and 12 cm.

**Concept Used:**

Perimeter = Sum of all sides of the triangle

**Calculation:**

The sides of the right-angled triangle are 5 cm and 12 cm.

Then, Base = 5 cm

Height = 12 cm

Hypotenuse = √(5)² + (12)² = √ 25 + 144 = √ 169 = 13 cm

Then, Perimeter = 5 + 12 +13 = 30 cm

**∴ The perimeter of a right-angle triangle is 30 cm.**

If sin θ - cos θ = (1)/({29)} find the value of sinθ + cosθ.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin θ - cos θ = (1)/({29)}

**Formula used:**

Sin²θ + Cos²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

Sinθ – Cosθ = 1/29

⇒ (Sinθ – Cosθ)² = (1/29)²

⇒ Sin2θ + Cos2θ – 2SinθCosθ = 1/841

⇒ 1 – 2SinθCosθ = 1/841

⇒ 1 – 1/841 = 2SinθCosθ

⇒ 840/841 = 2SinθCosθ

(Sinθ + Cosθ)²

⇒ Sin2θ + Cos2θ + 2SinθCosθ

⇒ 1 + 840/841

⇒ {(841 + 840)/841}

⇒ 1681/841

⇒ 41/29

**∴ The value of sinθ + cosθ is 41/29**

d² = 2 - 1/841

d = 41/29

questions.question: The average of four consecutive even numbers is 27. By adding which number does the average become 28?
questions.solution:

Average = (Sum of total observations)/(Total Number of observation)

**Calculation:**

Let 'x' be added to the number then new average is 28.

(Sum of total observations) = (Total Number of observation) × Average

a + a + 2 + a + 4 + a + 6 = 27 × 4

⇒ 4a + 12 = 108 

⇒ 4a = 96

⇒ a = 24

(Sum of total observations) = (Total Number of observation) × Average

⇒ (a) + (a + 2) + (a + 4) + (a + 6) + x = 28 × 5

⇒ 4a + 12 + x = 140

⇒ 108 + x = 140 

⇒ x = 32

questions.question: P can work thrice as fast as Q. Working independently, Q can complete a task in 24 days. In how many days can P and Q together finish the same task?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Efficiency of P = 3 × Efficiency of Q

Q can complete the work in 24 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × Time period

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of P be 3x

Let the efficiency of Q be x

Total work = 24 × x

P and Q can complete the (24 × x) work in {(24 × x)/(3x + x)} days

⇒ 24/4 = 6

**∴**** P and Q together finish the same task in 6 days.**

questions.question: The incomes of two persons P and Q are in the ratio 5 ∶ 6. If each of them saves Rs.200 per month, the ratio of their expenditures is 3 ∶ 4. Find the income of Q.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Income ratio of P and Q = 5 : 6

Individual savings of P and Q = ₹ 200

Expenditure ratio = 3 : 4

**Formula used:**

Profit = Investment × Time period

**Calculation:**

Let income of P be 5x

Let income of Q be 6x

(5x – 200)/(6x – 200) = 3/4

⇒ 20x – 800 = 18x – 600

⇒ 20x – 18x = 800 – 600

⇒ 2x = 200

⇒ x = 100

Income of P = 100 × 5 = 500

Income of Q = 100 × 6 = 600

**∴**** The income of Q is 600.**

questions.question: The wheel of a car has 210 cm diameter. How many revolutions per minute must the wheel make so that the speed of the car is kept at 120 km/h?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter if wheel,D = 210 cm = 2.1 m

Speed of car, v = 120 km/hour

**Formula used:**

V = (πDN)/60

V → speed, D → diameter, N → number of revolution

**Calculatioon:**

V = (πDN)/60

⇒ 120 × 5/18 = (π × 2.1 × N)/60

1 km/hour = 5/18 m/s

⇒ N = (120 × 5 × 60)/(18 × 2.1 × π)

⇒ N = 303.03

**∴ Revolution of wheel in a minute is 303.03**

questions.question: If a positive integer n is divided by 7, the remainder is 2. Which of the numbers in the options yields a remainder of 0 when it is divided by 7?
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

n is a positive integer

n is divided by 7, remainder is 2

**Calculation:**

Let k is any integer.

⇒ n = 7k + 2

By trial and error method

Option 1,

⇒ n + 2 = 7k + 2 + 2

⇒ n + 2 = 7k + 4

⇒ When n + 2 is divided by 7, the remainder is 4.

Option 2,

⇒ n + 1 = 7k + 2 + 1

⇒ n + 1 = 7k + 3

⇒ When n + 1 is divided by 7, the remainder is 3.

Option 3,

⇒ n + 3 = 7k + 2 + 3

⇒ n + 3 = 7k + 5

⇒ When n + 3 is divided by 7, the remainder is 5

Option 4,

⇒ n + 5 = 7k + 2 + 5

⇒ n + 5 = 7k + 7

⇒ When n + 5 is divided by 7, the remainder is 0.

**∴ The n + 5 yields the remainder 0.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd67c9563cdde4a0dfe99b7686282bc07365f691adfb64c907de66aebe4b011.png] **

Let k is any integer.

⇒ n = 7k + 2

Put k = 1

⇒ n = 7(1) + 2

⇒ n = 9

⇒ The multiple of 7 nearest to 9 is 14

⇒ 14 – 9 = 5

⇒ 5 should be added to n

∴ The n + 5 yields the remainder 0.

questions.question: Two circles touch each other externally. The distance between their centres is 8 cm. If the radius of one circle is 3 cm, then the radius of the other circle is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Two circles touch each other externally, 

Distance between their centres = 8 cm

Radius of 1st circle = 3 cm 

**Formula used: **

When two circles touch each other externally then the distance between their centres is given by the sum of their radii 

Distance between centres = Radius of 1st circle + Radius of 2ⁿd circle 

**Calculation: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0297b697b36851539362625eddb2c0e0bc711b4a5bee04244f50765446acba9.png] 

Let ‘r’ be the radius of 2ⁿd circle

According to the question,

⇒ 8 = 3 + r

⇒ r = 8 – 3 = 5 cm

**∴ The radius of other circle is 5 cm.**

questions.question: Find the value of sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + ... ... ... ... ... . infty } } } }
questions.solution:
**Given: **

**sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + ... ... ... ... ... . infty } } } } ** 

**Calculation: **

Let 'a' be the value of sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + ... ... ... ... ... . infty } } } } 

⇒ a = sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + ... ... ... ... ... . infty } } } } 

Squaring both sides, we get 

⇒ a² = 30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + ... ... ... ... ... . infty } } } } 

⇒ a² = 30 + a 

⇒ a² - a - 30 = 0 

⇒ a² - 6a + 5a - 30 = 0 

⇒ (a - 6)(a + 5) = 0 

⇒ a = 6, -5 

a = - 5 is not possible

**∴ The value of sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + sqrt {30 + ... ... ... ... ... . infty } } } } is 6.**

questions.question: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 125 cm. If the base is 33 cm, find the length of the equal sides.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 125 cm

And the base = 33 cm

**Concept used:**

An isosceles triangle is a that has two sides of equal length.

**Formula used:**

P = (2a + b)

Where,

P = Perimeter, a = Two equal sides, b = Base

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the each sides be x cm

P = (2a + b)

⇒ 125 = (2x + 33)

⇒ (125 – 33) = 2x

⇒ 2x = 92

⇒ x = 92/2 = 46

**∴ The length of the equal sides is 46 cm.**
